message: 決意と思惑と

name: Macaron
message: 「Hah...! Yah...! Taaah...!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hah...! Seih...!」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Phew」

name: Macaron
message: 「I feel kinda restless...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is it because things were left half-finished yesterday, or something...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Feeling all fuzzy and conflicted like this means...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Maybe I really do love Big Brother after all...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Yeah, that's gotta be it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Today...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, my feelings are still a little all over the place today, so... tomorrow!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Tomorrow, I'll definitely tell Big Brother」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I'm going to be a proper Demon Lord, something like that is...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I'm a Demon Lord...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I can't really call myself a Demon Lord while I'm still losing to Big Brother and the others, can I...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Alright, it's decided!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Tomorrow, once I beat Big Brother and the others, I'll properly tell him I love him!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll win, and give Big Brother a proper answer!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then this fuzzy feeling will go away, I'll get closer to becoming the Demon Lord, and Big Brother and I will truly acknowledge each other...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, tomorrow is Big Brother's birthday!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If it's a special day, I feel like I can muster up the courage!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aaaalright, I swear on Alzard that I'm definitely gonna win!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn. Wanna have a study session together tomorrow?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, sounds good~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then the location is decided--the President's house, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone's suddenly getting motivated right before the test.」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, it's better than having no motivation at all, isn't it?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll help out too~\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, we're meeting at Synn's place at noon!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Make sure none of you slack off!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes, ma'am~」

name: Melilot
message: 「Looking up at the sky like that--what are you brooding over?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, doesn't it suit me?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, astonishingly so.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey now, even I get a little hurt by that, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, please show at least a hint of it.」

name: Helena
message: 「Would that get you more fired up?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Shall we both leave the jokes at that?」

name: Helena
message: 「I don't think the situation is urgent enough to panic just yet, though.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You've noticed it too, haven't you, Helena?」

name: Helena
message: 「The number of shooting stars has been increasing...」

name: Helena
message: 「That means Re-Crea is progressing toward its peak phase, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. However, a scale and rate of progression like this do not exist in any past observation records.」

name: Helena
message: 「So a third party's intentions are involved.」

name: Melilot
message: 「We can't rule out the possibility」

name: Helena
message: 「So you're saying we need to look into it a little more」

name: Melilot
message: 「It wouldn't hurt to take precautions early」

name: Helena
message: 「True. Still, there's no need to worry」

name: Helena
message: 「Because if push comes to shove, a wonderful Demon Lord will come to our rescue\s07」

name: Melilot
message: 「I certainly hope things go that smoothly, though...」
